observations.humor_and_voices: Neet repeatedly mistakes attendance for top billing: the wrong-end macaron pause, cupcake knight, adjustable basket throne and generous-host acquiescence build specific comic self-importance. Buddy shares the theatrical pride but has distinct appetite, practical paw placements, a choice to steady the lid, flower-girl partner pursuit and an absurd elevated macaron reconnaissance payoff. Sagar catches the lantern while Heather turns and plays along; their concise exchange gives both humans participation.
observations.cause_effect_and_pacing: The spilled bowl produces a cautious step and butterfly stillness without compromising ring duty. The ring delivery yields applause then the necessary handoff to the humans. Neet shifting to keep his audience causes the basket lid to dip; Buddy braces it. Lantern contact produces the catch within the dance. The sections move from ceremony to reception to sunset without requiring invented chronology.
observations.earned_ending: Gold pillow begins as serious ring duty, appears empty beside the family, then becomes Buddy’s chin rest. The final sleep maintains that state. Affection follows successful duty and shared mischief; the final humorous assignment line preserves a light close.
observations.source_comparison: Read full prior working text and full archived reader-36 source. Guest cast, ceremonial costumes, cupcake knight, butterfly, boutique original, calendar exchange, lantern mishap, flower-girl ascent and sunset family scene remain. New local beats add consequences and agency without changing the source emotional destination.
observations.complementarity: Dog-level ceremony stillness, wider human dance recovery and rear-view quiet pond gathering offer three distinct narrative contributions and scales. No redundant adjacent flower-girl picture or primary-only alternative insertion.
